description: Enriched derived table for the S5 Triad. Each state includes: identity classification (zone/phase/signal/conviction), frequency, pivot probabilities with lift, anticipation timing (median bars to ZZ5 turns), forward returns at +5/10/20 days, per-tier breakdown, and alpha vs SPY.

signal_classification.RARE_EVENT: N < 20. Informational only, not actionable for sizing.

signal_type_classification.LEADING: Median bars to target turn <= 10. Signal anticipates the pivot.
signal_type_classification.COINCIDENT: 10 < Median bars <= 20. Signal arrives with the pivot.
signal_type_classification.LAGGING: Median bars > 20. Signal confirms after the pivot.

methodology.conviction_score: 0-95 scale. Base from signal type, adjusted for N (±15), WR confirmation (±10). HIGH >= 70, MEDIUM 45-69, LOW < 45.
methodology.cascade_phase: Describes position in the breadth cycle. Recovery cascade: TW recovers first → FI → TH. Distribution cascade: TW falls first → FI → TH.
